scope: Source-first qualification of PersonController DELETE request-header echo only; both Original and observed upstream Default on this host.

criteria.required: Reobserve dotnet/aspnetcore default branch read-only with UTC time and actual result. Resolve exact commit objects locally without fetching or updating shared refs. Retain complete source bytes, Git memberships and hashes for the finite relevant files at both roles. If current Default is missing or changed beyond available evidence, record the precise limitation rather than silently using an old pin.

Trace real DELETE request creation, explicit and framework-created headers, available cardinality/backing-representation evidence, endpoint routing and lifecycle, response construction and actual endpoint consumer/assertions. Distinguish source evidence from observed runtime behavior and unknown browser/transport-added headers.

Establish StringValues.ToArray backing-specific behavior, actual string.Join overload selection and relevant ToString null/empty/multiple-value semantics from pinned authoritative source. Include ordering, comma delimiters, and the difference between null and empty elements. Do not equate ToArray with copying or IEnumerable Join with an improvement.
Capture focused path history and relevant documentation plus bounded read-only upstream and fork related-work results; preserve every actual query result and failure.

Admit only the smallest private candidate supported by a faithful real-producer correctness path and a materiality rationale. An informational test asset plus already-array-specialized common inputs may justify a bounded source-level no-candidate gate; do not fabricate request rate, header volume, hot loops or performance claims.

No native execution unless a candidate survives and actual owner registry GO, lease absence and no explicit actual HOLD are freshly checked before every start. Exact local graph SDK 12.0.100-alpha.1.26557.102, required environment before activation, at most two nodes, no node reuse/shared compilation, existing projects and actual producer-to-observable correctness only. No timing, counters, warmup or restore without an actual missing-dependency failure. Behavioral fixes require expected red/green for every row.

Preserve reserved tracked and four inherited untracked report files unchanged, leave policy/registry/lease/campaign ledger untouched, retain all executed scripts/attempts/corrections, empty or candidate diff index, source/materiality/native/runtime limitations and actual owned-process terminal state. End with one HANDOFF.json and a complete nonrecursive SHA256 artifact index covering it.

validationBoundary.lowerBoundaryFalsePassRisk: Directly constructing arbitrary StringValues or invoking a controller bypasses browser/HttpClient/HTTP parser producers; source reasoning alone is not runtime verification
validationBoundary.browserEvidenceRationale: No DOM, rendering, timing, browser lifecycle or JS event claim is proposed; stop at the lowest faithful server/header boundary unless evidence requires otherwise

excluded: Public API or new test harness
Benchmarks, timing, profiling, counters and workload inflation
Commits, pushes, PRs, issues or GitHub writes
Policy, registry, lease, campaign ledger or manifest/SDK pin changes
